note: THE REAL VIEW of the owner's reference photos (art/source/owner_refs/imgur_TXI6i3E.jpg, a friend's private archive, used with permission, not redistributed): standing on the access road to Hotel Posta at Biela Put, looking along it. The photo maps to the frame as game = (photo - (244, 124)) * 1.15. Camera ~2.8 m above the road (the photographer's height, measured from the people in the photo), horizon y ~347; perspective s(y) = (y - 347) / 839, i.e. ~99 px per metre at the road's far walkable end (y 612) and ~240 px per metre at the bottom. Left: the snowy verge with two benches, the stream with boulders and the arched wooden footbridge with its X-lattice railing; middle distance: the steep-gabled wooden chalet of Hotel Posta at the end of the road; right: the stone-clad retaining wall along the road with a gap and three granite steps up to the groomed snow field (piste run-out), the ticket gate in the gap mouth, the signpost on the wall top, the white bullwheel housing and low hall of the gondola station behind the fence, the steel tube pylon at the right edge and the two ropes with cabins, the rocky slope under snow. Walkable: the ploughed asphalt only (snow banks on both sides stay outside).
